Some systems not operational: Some systems not operational ({{down}} out of {{total}})
No data available: No data available, please make sure you have deployed your workers with latest config and check your worker status!
There are no incidents for this month: There are no incidents for this month.
Monitor State not defined: Monitor State is not defined now, please check your worker's status and binding!
Probe all unreachable: All probes with fresh results cannot reach this host.
Probe mixed explanation: Probes with fresh results disagree. Expand each probe to compare.
Probe unknown explanation: No fresh results from assigned probes. This does not establish that the host is unreachable.
Probe stale explanation: This probe has stopped reporting fresh results. Its last check is historical; the host status is unknown from this probe.
Probe failure history limit: Shows the latest 100 failed checks retained for this probe and host. Stage totals include all retained failures.
Probe overall mixed: Some systems have partial reachability or unknown status
Probe incidents limit: The latest 200 failed checks across all probes are available here, drawn from up to 100 retained failures per probe and host. Expand a host on the status page for full stage totals.
Probe no failed checks in month: No failed checks for this month in the recent retained results.
Probe uptime observation explanation: Uptime is the percentage of received checks that succeeded. Missing checks are excluded, not counted as failures. Days use UTC.
Probe latency gaps explanation: Five-minute averages are drawn only for buckets with no failures. Missing, failed and mixed buckets break the line.
Probe successful bucket average explanat: Average latency includes only checks in entirely successful five-minute buckets.
Probe scheduled maintenance: Scheduled maintenance is active for this monitor.
Probe history retention explanation: Automated history is retained for 90 days. Browse by month and load older pages to inspect every retained event. Published maintenance has its own history.
Probe history load error: History could not be loaded. Change the month or monitor to retry.
Probe failed check semantics: Each row is a failed check reported by one probe. It is not an inferred outage duration; a probe that reports nothing is not recorded as a failure.
Probe native incident semantics: Native incidents run from the first failed check until the next successful check. Reason changes are listed within each episode.
Probe no native incidents: No native incidents in this month.
Probe incident awaiting report: Unresolved; waiting for fresh check data
